non_header_contacts.description: Visible in rear drawing; not additional numbered headers in schematic or pad drawing. Do not assign new header IDs or infer probe continuity from these legends; physical pad/rail identification remains unverified.
Camera strobe test point connected to J2 pin 1; no STM32 connection drawn. Not counted among the 92 numbered header contacts.

notes: All92 exposed pin-header contacts P1/P2/P3 are included once. FPC/USB/microSD mating contacts are identified as onboard connectors rather than additional pin headers.
Only the first module revision marking has been bench-confirmed. Per-contact continuity, bridge population and the second module revision remain unverified.
The board drawing contains front and mirrored rear views. Use numbered pads on page1 for pin identity, not unqualified left/right counting from page3.
Do not infer a malfunction from a shared net. Firmware-PC8/microSDD0 and diagnostic-PD13/QSPIIO3 are actual overlaps, with assembly/functional consequences untested.
Vendor net names USB1_DN/USB1_DP are schematic names: on STM32H743 PA11/PA12 serve USB2_OTG_FS, not the PB14/PB15 USB1 controller. Do not infer controller identity from the vendor net prefix.
U7 and U8 are drawn as separate W25Qxx devices, each default W25Q64 64Mbit/8MB. Actual flash population and capacity were not inspected.
